items.note: Still resolved with the jdbc-data-access registration. Course order bound by curriculum pointers in authoring/catalog/sql-jdbc-foundations/**/topic.json: /tracks/0/weeks/4/days/1 (F22) = reporting-indexes-and-review/subqueries-and-ctes, window-functions-top-n-per-group, indexes, query-plans-with-explain; /tracks/0/weeks/4/days/2 (F23) = jdbc-data-access/connecting-java-to-postgres-with-jdbc, prepared-statements-and-sql-injection, transactions-and-acid, swapping-the-in-memory-repository-for-a-jdbc-one, testing-a-repository-against-a-test-database (rows 0-4, relation shared, calendarDayIds F23) plus reporting-indexes-and-review/jdbc-data-access-project (rows 0-4, exact); /tracks/0/weeks/4/days/3 (F24) = reporting-indexes-and-review/sql-review-joins-grouping-window-functions and jdbc-review. course.json moduleOrder [relational-design, crud-aggregates-and-joins, jdbc-data-access, reporting-indexes-and-review] is structural grouping, because reporting-indexes-and-review spans F22-F24 and cannot sit wholly before or after the F23 bridge without a split; delivered day order stays F22, F23, F24. Within F23 the bridge pages are the guided first part of the Build block (module-plan.md: 52 of 80 Build minutes, then the 15-minute project brief and a 13-minute lab start), so the bridge precedes the F23 project, and both precede the F24 reviews and the F24 sql-module-check. The intake commitment (intake.md lines 74 and 127-142: a required F23 project brief and topic lab with outcomes for all five rows, sequenced before F24) is unchanged; the registration adds a guaranteed teach-and-do experience for each F23 row before the project and review, strengthening the original remedy. Residual, not blocking (captain-directed, recorded in jdbc-data-access/module.json and module-plan.md): intake.md line 35 still states modules follow calendar day order and line 74 still says the per-row slugs are not created as topics; the 80-minute lab plan in intake.md is superseded by the module plan's 38-minute lab (13 F23 Build minutes plus F24's 25-minute Practice without AI block), still within the 30-60 minute lab budget.

Still resolved on the current intake bytes (unchanged since bf79ae4a): the lab plan (lines 120-131) runs every lab, including the F23 project lab, against the learner-local PostgreSQL server through pinned pgJDBC, with an isolated database created and dropped by the one Maven test command and no H2 or container engine. The new bridge pages are simulations that rehearse that real PostgreSQL workflow (PGHOST/PGPORT/PGDATABASE settings, a created and dropped test database) and do not replace the real lab.

Still resolved on the current blueprint bytes (unchanged since bf79ae4a): formats MCQ and coding, 45 minutes, pass mark 70; the coding format maps jdbc-review#o1 (connect, prepare, execute, read, close) and jdbc-data-access-project#o2 alongside four SQL objectives, and the learner instructions name writing SQL and querying with JDBC. With the registration, those JDBC objectives are now taught on F23 by the bridge pages before the F24 check.
